rule.pattern: signin.keyboard-open: None — Potentially valid partial entry; no early length error
rule.appLogic: app-logic §2: Checks, most basic first: empty → "Enter your mobile number." · more than 10 digits → "That’s more than 10 digits. Check the number." (shown as soon as it's typed, whatever the first digit; same place and style as the other field errors, D-101 o04) · first digit not 6/7/8/9 → "Mobile numbers start with 6, 7, 8 or 9." (shown as soon as it's typed) · fewer than 10 digits → "Enter all 10 digits." (shown on Send OTP). Once an error shows, it re-checks on every keystroke.
